subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memory accept arbitrary JSONL from `memorySearch.extraPaths`, or should structured raw-log ingestion remain an explicit session-memory, QMD, converter, or memory-plugin workflow?
rationale: Current main deliberately separates user-authored Markdown memory from schema-aware, redacted session-transcript JSONL, so broadening the builtin source changes privacy and memory semantics that cannot be settled by extension filtering alone.

options.title: Keep builtin Markdown-focused
options.body: Preserve the current boundary and document a converter or memory-plugin workflow for arbitrary structured logs.

options.title: Design a typed JSONL source
options.body: Add an explicit schema-aware source with redaction, field selection, limits, line mapping, retrieval, watcher behavior, docs, and focused security tests.

recommendation.title: Keep builtin Markdown-focused
recommendation.body: Preserve the current boundary and document a converter or memory-plugin workflow for arbitrary structured logs.

likelyOwner.reason: He carried the memory plugin/SDK ownership refactors and already provided maintainer-side direction on this issue.
